request:
Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Slag Hound".

Creative brief
Name: Slag Hound
Collection: Ashforge Remnants. Abandoned forge creatures and half-living constructs powered by coals, slag, chains, soot, and unstable furnace heat.
Core concept: A pursuit enemy that sheds dangerous molten fragments whenever it changes direction.
Body and silhouette: Low canine frame with heavy forequarters, jagged legs, and a cracked molten spine.
Signature features: Slag-plated hide, furnace-bright mouth, and a chain fragment around the neck.
Palette and materials: Charcoal black, rust red, molten orange, and cooled stone gray.
Movement personality: Aggressive, relentless, and unevenly heavy.
Attack concept: Chases in short bursts and drops a pair of glowing slag fragments whenever it pivots sharply.
Directional details: A broken chain trails from the left side of its collar.
Avoid: Ordinary fire wolf, smooth lava blob, flames replacing the entire body.
